caption:
Spam comments piling up? 🧹 Three simple settings:

1️⃣ Settings > Discussion > hold comments for approval
2️⃣ Install an anti-spam plugin like Akismet
3️⃣ Turn off comments on pages that don't need them

📌 Save this checklist.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

scenes.text: Spam comments are flooding your WordPress site?
scenes.sub: Three settings stop most of it.
scenes.say: Spam comments are flooding your WordPress site? Three settings stop most of it.

scenes.title: Hold comments for approval
items: Nothing shows until you say so
scenes.say: One. Go to Settings, then Discussion. Choose to hold comments for approval. Nothing shows until you say so.

scenes.title: Add an anti-spam plugin
scenes.body: A free one like Akismet filters spam for you.
scenes.say: Two. Add an anti-spam plugin. A free one like Akismet filters spam for you.
scenes.shown: Two. Add an anti-spam plugin. A free one like Akismet filters spam for you.

scenes.title: Turn comments off where unneeded
scenes.say: Three. Turn comments off where you do not need them. Keep them for blog posts, switch them off on pages.

scenes.label: delete the spam already waiting
scenes.say: Finally, empty the spam folder to clear what is already there.
